params.prompt: Premium mobile-game UI key art, full-bleed 16:9, no empty margins. The three attached images are QUALITY and STYLE references only (3D-rendered chunky Roblox-blocky hero props with bevels, specular highlights and soft contact shadows, layered 2D UI chrome on top, blurred depth-of-field diorama scene, extruded 3D title lettering with stroke and gradient, pill labels): match that craft level, but do NOT copy their titles, props layout or text. Original game: Blackout Crew, a kid-friendly co-op heist vs the Directive, a gray megacorp AI; our identity is colorful glitch versus gray. Deadpan humor, no blood, no real guns, no real brands or place names. Squad colors sky blue #56B4E9, orange #E69F00, green #009E73, pink-purple #CC79A7. Rich cinematic lighting, soft specular highlights and rim light. Soft warm glow ONLY on the TODAY item; no neon or emissive glow anywhere else. Seven days, DAY 1 to DAY 7. Exact state logic: DAY 1 and DAY 2 are CLAIMED with green check badges, DAY 3 is TODAY (largest, lit, raised, callout), DAY 4 to DAY 7 are LOCKED with padlock pills and dimmed. Show: close X top-right, '2 DAY STREAK' counter, huge CLAIM button, small timer pill 'NEXT REWARD 12H 36M', and a tomorrow teaser. Rewards are 3D props: Credits cash stacks, spray can (Spray Tag), kart decal sheet, ping icon token, loot crates, Day 7 grand prize crate with a Static Face Mask. Keep on-image text minimal, large, exact and legible; no tiny paragraphs. CONCEPT B variant, title 'GETAWAY ROUTE' extruded 3D white/orange. Layout: tilted top-down isometric city map in the lower two-thirds, route snaking left to right across 7 rooftop stash pads with 3D props (cash, spray can, decal sheet, crates), kart parked at DAY 3 pad with lit crate; gray drone sentries on locked pads; big CLAIM button bottom-right; Directive tower with vault top-right.
